Messages.Author: rai...@mich.com
Messages.Body:
Well a few more questions came up with the SCS.

1) How often is the combat card on the SCS usable. Once per round, once per
combat, as often as legal. This question came to light when the SCS was
given a damage prevention card.

2) The card text states the SCS has the ability to use cards. Does this
inherent ability allowed to be used in conjuction with their normal strike?
The card text does not state, but does lean toward a liberal view. If the
ability is just like a vampires ability for agro or additional damage, then
the combat card could be used in addition to the hand strike. What is the
Official ruling on this?

Raille

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
In article <6hcn3a$gps$1...@nnrp1.dejanews.com>,

rai...@mich.com wrote:
>
> Well a few more questions came up with the SCS.
>
> 1) How often is the combat card on the SCS usable. Once per round, once per
> combat, as often as legal. This question came to light when the SCS was
> given a damage prevention card.

Since it says "During X, Satyr may do Y", where X is "combat" and Y is
"use the card's ability", he may use the card's ability once per combat.

> 2) The card text states the SCS has the ability to use cards. Does this
> inherent ability allowed to be used in conjuction with their normal strike?
> The card text does not state, but does lean toward a liberal view. If the
> ability is just like a vampires ability for agro or additional damage, then
> the combat card could be used in addition to the hand strike. What is the
> Official ruling on this?

I'm not following you here. If the card is a strike card, then the Satyr
may strike with that card. He cannot do so in addition to striking without
the card for the same strike. You get one strike per strike, always.

If the card is not a strike card, then it can be used, and the Satyr chooses
his strike (when the time comes) as normal.

If this does not answer your question, please restate the question.

--
L. Scott Johnson (vte...@wizards.com)

In article <6hgd6o$6dj$1...@nnrp1.dejanews.com>,
cbo...@apdi.net wrote:
>
>
> > Since it says "During X, Satyr may do Y", where X is "combat" and Y is
> > "use the card's ability", he may use the card's ability once per combat.
>
> Ok, I never really thought about it until now, but the above doesn't really
> make a whole lot of sense.
> If we are talking about combat (X is "combat"), combat is/can be along
> drawn out ordeal with each individual round happening "during combat".
> I don't see how "During X, Satyr may do Y" limits 'Y' to being usable
> only once.

It has been ruled to mean so:

"During phase X, do Y" limits Y to once per phase X.

> "During the movie, I may talk". Does that mean I can only talk once
> during the movie?

No, because it doesn't fit the template. X in the template is an event,
not an on-going activity.

"During the move, you may say one sentence" means that you can say only
one sentence during the movie.'

> "During the walk, I may whistle". Does that mean I can only whistle
> once during the walk?

No, because it doesn't fit the template.

"During your walk, you may whistle one note" means that you can whistle
one note during the walk.
